drawings.description: matrice par blocs de $\sigma_i$, $(n+2)\times(n+2)$ : bloc identité d'ordre $i-1$ en haut à gauche ; bloc $2\times 2$ $\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$ aux places $i,i+1$ ; à droite, sur les lignes $1$ à $i+1$, les coefficients $\lambda_{i1}\ \lambda_{i1}\cdots\lambda_{i1}$, \ldots, $\lambda_{ii}\cdots\lambda_{ii}$, $\lambda_{i,i+1}\cdots\lambda_{i,i+1}$ ; sur les $n-i$ dernières lignes, la diagonale $\lambda_{i,i+2}$ ; dernière colonne de translation nulle, $1$ en bas à droite. Les accolades marquent « $i-1$ », « $2$ », « $n-i$ », « $i+1$ ».
drawings.notes: The matrix of sigma_i entry by entry, at the places where he wrote them: identity block 1, dots, 1 at the top left with a large 0 beside it; a flat oval (a zero block) and the block (0 1 / 1 0) on the rows i, i+1; the rows lambda_{i1} lambda_{i1} ... lambda_{i1}, lambda ----, lambda_{ii} ... lambda_{ii}, lambda_{i,i+1} ... lambda_{i,i+1}; then the diagonal lambda_{i,i+2} with zeros, a large oval 0 under the 2-block; last column 0, ..., 0, 1; last row 0 --- 0, 0 ... 0. Braces: over the columns i-1, 2, n-i; on the left i-1, 2, n-i; on the right i+1 and n-i. Struck out and omitted: the row between lambda ---- and lambda_{ii} (a struck lambda entry), an overwritten 0 in the last row, and a struck letter before the left brace n-i. Left out: a brace between the lambda block and the last column whose label is unreadable. The text line above the matrix and the formula below are text. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128) after Michel's check: vertices placed once and every edge drawn between them, so concurrent lines meet exactly; labels at \small. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): laid over the scan rendered at 350 dpi in colour, whole and zoomed (25 px a unit); not compiled (no TeX engine in the session), the TikZ was rasterised by a script. The parentheses, the braces, the ovals and the entries lie at their places within about 1 unit. Added: the brace between the lambda block and the last column (a doubled stroke on the page, running from the first lambda row to the row lambda_{i,i+1}), drawn without its label, a small scribble at the cusp that is not read. The struck entries stay left out as struck.

Every edge is drawn between the 12 vertices, so the 30 edges meet exactly at them: each outer vertex joined to its 3 neighbours on the middle ring, s_2 to s'_3, s''_3, s-bar_3, s_0 to s'_3, s_3, s-bar''_3, s_1 to s''_3, s_3, s-bar'_3. The combinatorics is checked as a polyhedron (12 vertices, 30 edges, 20 faces). On the page the edges s_0 s_3 and s_1 s_3 are slightly bowed and the line s-bar''_3 s_0 s_1 s-bar'_3 is drawn in one stroke; here they are straight. Left out: the faint pencil construction lines under the ink, and the long pencil curve under the figure (it separates the figure from the formulas below).
